---
page-layout: full
format: html
listing:
  id: project-listing
  contents:
    - "phd-project/index.qmd"
  type: default
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  fields: [image, title, description, categories]
---

::: {#project-listing}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const destination = "../phd/";

  document.querySelectorAll("#listing-project-listing .quarto-post").forEach((project) => {
    project.setAttribute("role", "link");
    project.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");

    project.querySelectorAll("a").forEach((link) => {
      link.href = destination;
    });

    project.querySelectorAll(".listing-category").forEach((category) => {
      category.removeAttribute("onclick");
    });

    project.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      if (!event.target.closest("a")) {
        window.location.href = destination;
      }
    });

    project.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
        event.preventDefault();
        window.location.href = destination;
      }
    });
  });
});
</script>
```
